goal: Determine whether the exact P029 Stage10/11 real-history population can be recomputed from information defensibly available by each historical decision cutoff, without substituting retrospective DWD reconstruction time or final-state data for historical availability.

target_clock.decision_cutoff: 15:30:00 Asia/Shanghai on each represented market date
target_clock.cutoff_rationale: Preserve the existing bounded Stage/F9 daily decision cutoff after the T close and before earliest T+1-open execution.
target_clock.platform_as_known_reason: Quanthus did not historically consume the 2020 observations and no contemporaneous platform receipt family exists; actual historical platform knowledge must not be reconstructed from present-day ingestion metadata.

frozen_population.source: P029 exact real-history Stage10-active observation population
frozen_population.selection_rule: all P029 Stage10-active observation identities; no resampling or replacement
frozen_population.causal_dependency_scope: the exact warm-up and same-process daily dependency closure required to recompute each selected observation

daily_bar.candidate_authority: governed session-completion economic-availability rule plus exact source-version evidence

corporate_action_coordinate_epoch.candidate_authority: announcement/availability evidence no later than cutoff plus effective-date semantics

quality_and_source_revision.candidate_authority: exact source_record_id/source_revision/source_artifact binding and contemporaneously admissible quality evidence

stage_semantics.parent_relation: Stage11 requires a prior immutable Stage10 confirmation on the same support process and does not replace the Stage10 context while the support remains unreclaimed.

questions: Can every exact source member required by the 10-observation causal closure be assigned a non-retrospective historical availability rule with authenticated evidence?
Can the complete relevant source revision family at each cutoff be proved rather than assumed from the present-day final file?
Can realized-session, identity and action-epoch dependencies be reconstructed without future-informed state?
Can unavailable dependencies be represented as unavailable without silently removing or replacing P029 observations?
capability_audit.early_stop: If any required evidence class is structurally unavailable for the frozen population and cannot be established from already governed historical evidence, stop before result-bearing Stage replay and convene four-party scope review.

replay_acceptance.reason_retrospective_match_not_required: A valid PIT result may legitimately differ from the retrospective result; divergence is evidence, not an implementation failure.

four_party_review_required_before_contin: target clock view or purpose changes
source authority expands or substitutes a new historical dataset
any strict evidence rule is weakened
pass criterion changes from complete 10/10 reconstruction
